name: v1.58.9 — Fixes and improvements
body:
## What's Changed
* cli: fix WorkspaceRoot looping forever on a .git file by @pujitha24 in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2620
* Update README.md by @marcuskohlberg in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2622
* Fix LLM rules setup and update LLM instructions by @marcuskohlberg in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2623
* runtime: keep pubsub topics and buckets from all infra config providers by @jaglyserx in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2628
* v2/app/legacymeta: stop metadata keeping the parsed app alive by @twindebank in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2630
* v2/internals/pkginfo: resolve nested modules missing from the module cache by @eandre in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2638
* sqldb: add 10 minutes of jitter to connection lifetimes by default by @gmtuca in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2637
* runtimes: log in to Cloud SQL with GCP IAM database authentication by @ekerfelt in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2640
* Revert "runtimes: log in to Cloud SQL with GCP IAM database authentication (#2640)" by @ekerfelt in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2641
* runtimes: re-land GCP IAM database login, keeping the password in ConnString by @ekerfelt in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2646
* tsparser: fall back to later export conditions by @eandre in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2648
* cli/cmd/encore/daemon: open encore.db without the shared cache by @twindebank in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2631
* pkg/paths: compare cleaned paths in FS.HasPrefix outside Windows by @twindebank in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2632
* v2/app: look up ServiceForPath in a map of service roots by @twindebank in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2633
* internal/etrace, runtimes/go: read goroutine ids with 64 bytes, and skip untraced steps by @twindebank in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2634
* cli/daemon/sqldb/docker: check Docker is up with "docker version" by @twindebank in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2635
* runtimes/go: keep sub-second precision when encoding time.Time params by @Abhishek-B-R in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2629
* sqldb: close cursors that are left with rows unread by @ekerfelt in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2653

## New Contributors
* @pujitha24 made their first contribution in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2620
* @gmtuca made their first contribution in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2637
* @Abhishek-B-R made their first contribution in https://github.com/encoredev/encore/pull/2629

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/encoredev/encore/compare/v1.58.8...v1.58.9
